sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SYNOPTIC PATTERN WILL CHANGE LITTLE SATURDAY WITH AN UPPER RIDGE ANCHORED OVER THE SRN PLAINS INTO THE SRN ROCKIES AND BELT OF STRONGER WLYS OVER THE NRN TIER STATES. VIGOROUS SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW OVER SRN ALBERTA WILL CREST UPPER RIDGE AND DROP SEWD THROUGH ND AND MN SATURDAY AFTERNOON AND EVENING...CONTINUING INTO THE GREAT LAKES LATER SATURDAY NIGHT. ATTENDANT SURFACE LOW WILL DEVELOP THROUGH SRN ONTARIO WHILE TRAILING COLD FRONT ADVANCES SEWD THROUGH THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS AND UPPER MS VALLEY. FARTHER EAST A POSITIVE TILT LOW AMPLITUDE UPPER TROUGH WILL CONTINUE EWD AND OFF THE ATLANTIC SEABOARD. A COLD FRONT WILL ADVANCE INTO THE NERN STATES...BUT TRAILING PORTION OF THIS BOUNDARY WILL STALL OVER THE OH VALLEY AND EXTEND NWWD AS A WARM FRONT INTO THE MID MS VALLEY AND CNTRL PLAINS REGION.

sections.title: UPPER-MID MS VALLEY THROUGH ERN PORTIONS OF NRN/CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: SLY WINDS WITHIN GRADIENT ZONE BETWEEN RETREATING SFC RIDGE OVER ERN CANADA AND LEE/PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH WILL DEVELOP EWD THROUGH THE NRN PLAINS AND UPPER MS VALLEY SATURDAY. RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE SHOULD REMAIN CONFINED TO ALONG AND JUST SOUTH OF WARM FRONT ACROSS NEB/IA...WHILE LOW 60S DEWPOINTS SHOULD BE MAINTAINED FARTHER NORTH AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT FROM THE ERN DAKOTAS INTO MN. PLUME OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL ADVECT ABOVE THE MOIST AXIS WHICH IN CONJUNCTION WITH DIABATIC WARMING SHOULD RESULT IN AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. MLCAPE FROM 1500-2000 J/KG IS LIKELY FROM ERN ND INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY WITH 2000-3000 J/KG FARTHER SOUTH ACROSS SRN SD/NEB. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INITIATE OVER THE ERN DAKOTAS BY MID AFTERNOON ALONG COLD FRONT WITHIN ZONE OF HEIGHT FALLS AHEAD OF THE APPROACHING SHORTWAVE TROUGH. ACTIVITY WILL SUBSEQUENTLY DEVELOP INTO MN. FARTHER SOUTH...WEAKER DEEP FORCING AND A STRONGER CAP MAY DELAY INITIATION UNTIL LATER IN THE AFTERNOON ACROSS SRN SD AND NEB. WINDS ALOFT WILL STRENGTHEN WITH APPROACH OF A MID-LEVEL JET ATTENDING THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH WITH EFFECTIVE DEEP SHEAR INCREASING TO AOA 40 KT. INITIAL STORMS WILL LIKELY BE SUPERCELLS CAPABLE

sections.title: OH VALLEY INTO THE NERN STATES
sections.text: DIABATIC WARMING OF THE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO AROUND 70 WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE FROM 2000-3000 J/KG OVER THE OH VALLEY AND 1500 J/KG FARTHER EAST INTO THE NERN STATES WHERE WEAKER LAPSE RATES AND MORE CLOUDS ARE LIKELY. SCATTERED STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO ONCE AGAIN DEVELOP ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE FRONT DURING THE AFTERNOON WITHIN A WEAK SHEAR ENVIRONMENT. THE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES MAY SUPPORT A THREAT FOR MAINLY ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS THROUGH EARLY EVENING. A SLIGHT RISK MAY NEED TO BE INCLUDED FOR PORTIONS OF THIS AREA IN LATER UPDATES. ..DIAL/BUNTING.. 08/31/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PROMINENT MID/UPPER LEVEL FEATURE SUPPORTING STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS THIS FORECAST PERIOD IS A VIGOROUS SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER SRN SASKATCHEWAN PER SATELLITE IMAGERY...EXPECTED TO TRACK SEWD THROUGH ND AND MN THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. THIS TROUGH IS LOCATED WITHIN A STRONG BAND OF FLOW OVER THE NRN TIER STATES...AND SHOULD DEPART MN TONIGHT MOVING INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES. AN ATTENDANT SURFACE LOW WILL TRACK SEWD FROM SERN MANITOBA THROUGH NWRN ONTARIO REACHING LAKE SUPERIOR BY 12Z SUNDAY....WHILE A TRAILING COLD FRONT ADVANCES SEWD THROUGH THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS AND UPPER MS VALLEY. FARTHER EAST A POSITIVE TILT LOW AMPLITUDE UPPER TROUGH WILL CONTINUE EWD AND OFF THE ATLANTIC SEABOARD. A COLD FRONT WILL MOVE SEWD INTO THE NERN STATES...BUT TRAILING PORTION OF THIS BOUNDARY WILL LIKELY STALL OVER THE OH VALLEY AND EXTEND NWWD AS A WARM FRONT INTO THE MID MS/LOWER MO VALLEYS AND CNTRL PLAINS REGION.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY TO ERN PORTIONS OF THE NRN/CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: SLIGHT RISK ACROSS THIS REGION REMAINS ON TRACK AS A RELATIVELY NARROW PLUME OF GREATER MOISTURE /SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER-MID 60S/ RESIDE ACROSS THE ERN DAKOTAS INTO WRN MN TO CENTRAL NEB. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES SPREADING EWD ATOP THE MOISTURE AND COMBINED WITH SURFACE HEATING WILL RESULT IN MLCAPE OF 1500-2000 J/KG OVER ERN ND TO THE UPPER MS VALLEY...AND 2000-3000 J/KG OVER SRN SD INTO NEB. MODELS CONTINUE TO INDICATE TSTMS SHOULD FORM ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN ERN SD/FAR ERN ND INTO NRN AND WRN MN BETWEEN 20-23Z AS THE STRONGEST HEIGHT FALLS/FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE PROGRESSIVE TROUGH SPREAD ESEWD ACROSS THESE AREAS. FARTHER SOUTH...SURFACE HEATING WILL NEED TO COMPENSATE FOR WEAKER UPPER FORCING TO WEAKEN THE INHIBITION FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT. 50-60 KT WLY MIDLEVEL WINDS /AS OBSERVED WITH THE 12Z GGW SOUNDING/ WITHIN THE BASE OF THE SRN SASKATCHEWAN TROUGH WILL SPREAD ACROSS ERN ND/SD TO NRN/WRN MN LATE THIS AFTERNOON PROVIDING AMPLE DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS. GIVEN THE DEGREE OF SHEAR...INSTABILITY AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...THE INITIAL STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. A THREAT FOR

sections.title: OH VALLEY TO THE NERN STATES
sections.text: EARLY THIS MORNING...VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED CLOUDS MOVING ACROSS MUCH OF THE NERN STATES TO THE UPPER OH VALLEY...WHILE THE ONSET OF DIABATIC HEATING WILL BE GREATER ACROSS THE LOWER HALF OF THE OH VALLEY WHERE THERE WERE LESS CLOUDS. THUS...STRONGER INSTABILITY IS EXPECTED IN THE LOWER OH VALLEY WITH MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG FORECAST FOR THIS AFTERNOON...AND VALUES UP TO 1000-1500 J/KG IN FROM THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS TO THE MID ATLANTIC REGION AND SRN NY. TSTMS...INCLUDING IN THE WAKE OF ONGOING ACTIVITY MOVING S/SEWD THROUGH FAR SRN OH/IND AND ADJACENT NRN KY...ARE EXPECTED AS A COLD FRONT ADVANCES S/SEWD THE OH VALLEY AND PARTS OF THE NERN STATES. WEAK EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL TEND TO TEMPER THE POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED STORMS...BUT THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES SUGGEST MAINLY A THREAT FOR LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS. ..PETERS/SMITH.. 08/31/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: CONTINUED SWWD SUPPRESSION OF THE LARGE-SCALE CENTRAL AND SWRN U.S. UPPER RIDGE WILL CONTINUE THIS PERIOD...AS A SERIES OF SHORT-WAVE FEATURES WITHIN ENHANCED BELT OF FLOW ON THE NERN PERIPHERY OF THE RIDGE SHIFT EWD/SEWD IN AN ANTICYCLONIC ARC. THE STRONGEST OF THESE FEATURES -- SHIFTING ESEWD FROM THE SRN CANADIAN PRAIRIE AND ADJACENT NRN PLAINS AREA TOWARD THE UPPER MS VALLEY -- WILL CONTINUE TO DRIVE A COLD FRONT EWD TOWARD THE UPPER MS VALLEY AND SEWD TOWARD THE CENTRAL PLAINS/MID MO VALLEY. THIS PROGRESSION WILL FOCUS A ZONE OF PRIMARY SEVERE POTENTIAL THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. ELSEWHERE...WARM/LOCALLY UNSTABLE LOW-LEVEL AIRMASS AHEAD OF A WEAKER BAROCLINIC ZONE EXTENDING WSWWD FROM NEW ENGLAND INTO THE OH VALLEY AREA WILL ALSO SUPPORT A BROAD ZONE OF THUNDERSTORMS -- AND LOCAL/LOW-PROBABILITY SEVERE RISK -- THROUGH THIS EVENING.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS/UPPER MS VALLEY AREA SWWD INTO THE MO VALLEY
sections.text: A RELATIVELY POTENT/SUBSTANTIAL SHORT-WAVE TROUGH -- QUITE WELL DEFINED ATTM PER WV IMAGERY OVER SRN SASKATCHEWAN -- WILL CONTINUE SHIFTING ESEWD ACROSS THE DAKOTAS TOWARD MN AND THE UPPER MS VALLEY AREA. ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT NOW CROSSING ND/NWRN SD WILL LIKEWISE CONTINUE ITS EWD/ESEWD PROGRESSION...WHILE SLY RETURN OF MORE FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE CONTINUES AHEAD OF THE BOUNDARY. WITH DIURNAL HEATING OF THIS MOISTENING BOUNDARY LAYER...AFTERNOON MIXED-LAYER CAPE VALUES SHOULD REACH 1500 TO 2500 J/KG -- SUPPORTIVE OF STORM DEVELOPMENT. STORM INITIATION APPEARS LIKELY TO OCCUR IN THE 20Z TO 22Z TIME FRAME...WITHIN A ZONE FROM ERN ND TO NWRN MN. WITH MODERATE LOW-LEVEL SLYS VEERING TO WLY AT 40 TO 50 KT AT MID-LEVELS...RESULTING SHEAR WILL SUPPORT RAPID STORM ORGANIZATION -- WITH SUPERCELLS EXPECTED INITIALLY. AS SUCH...VERY LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE...ALONG WITH ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL. WITH TIME...UPSCALE GROWTH OF THE STORMS INTO A LINE/LINE SEGMENTS SEEMS LIKELY GIVEN LINEAR FORCING...AND THIS SCENARIO IS SUPPORTED BY SEVERAL HI-RES CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL RUNS WHICH DEPICT LINEAR/BOWING CONFIGURATION WITH THE CONVECTION AS IT APPROACHES THE

sections.title: SWRN NEW ENGLAND WSWWD INTO THE OH/TN VALLEY REGION
sections.text: THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING ATTM IN TWO PRIMARY CLUSTERS -- ONE WITHIN A ZONE OF WEAKENING WARM ADVECTION IN THE NRN IL/NRN INDIANA AREA AND THE OTHER OVER THE ERN KY VICINITY. WHILE THE NRN AREA OF STORMS SHOULD DIMINISH WITH TIME...THE STORMS ACROSS THE ERN KY AREA WILL LIKELY PERSIST...GIVEN OBSERVED ORGANIZATION OF THE LOW-LEVEL COLD POOL AND SUPPORTIVE DOWNSTREAM AIRMASS. WHILE MODEST FLOW ALOFT SHOULD ACT TO LIMIT SEVERE RISK...A FEW LOCALLY STRONGER GUSTS OR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL EVENTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE. REF SWOMCD #1813 FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS. OTHER CLUSTERS OF CONVECTION WILL LIKELY EVOLVE WITHIN THE BROADER AREA FROM SRN NEW ENGLAND WSWWD INTO THE OH/TN VALLEY REGION AS THE PRE-FRONTAL AIRMASS LOCALLY DESTABILIZES THIS AFTERNOON. AGAIN HOWEVER...OVERALL SEVERE POTENTIAL SHOULD REMAIN LIMITED BY THE LACK OF MORE SUBSTANTIAL FLOW FIELD ALOFT. ..GOSS/MOSIER.. 08/31/2013

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST/MIDDLE MO VALLEY
sections.text: GENERAL FORECAST SCENARIO HAS CHANGED LITTLE...BUT SOME SPATIAL/PROBABILISTIC ADJUSTMENTS WERE MADE BASED ON THE LATEST CONVECTIVE TRENDS/SHORT-TERM GUIDANCE. SOMEWHAT HIGHER WIND PROBABILITIES WERE INTRODUCED FOR ANTICIPATED DOMINANCE OF A QUASI-LINEAR/CLUSTER MODE...BEYOND AN INITIAL SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELL RISK. FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS ON THE REGION...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS 1814 AND 1816 AND SEVERE TSTM WATCH 507.

sections.title: MIDWEST/LOWER OH VALLEY
sections.text: A CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN ADDED FOR PORTIONS OF IL/INDIANA/KY FOR A SEVERE WIND/HAIL THREAT MAINLY THROUGH EARLY/MID EVENING. FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1815. ..GUYER.. 08/31/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1131 AM CDT SAT AUG 31 2013/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTER OF CONVECTION OVER ERN KY HAS GROWN SUFFICIENTLY UPSCALE TO ORGANIZE FORWARD-PROPAGATING OUTFLOW THAT MAY ENGENDER ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT ALONG ITS LEADING EDGE...IN TURN REINFORCING PRECIP LOADING TO DRIVE COLD POOL. GUSTS SHOULD REMAIN LARGELY SUB-SVR WITH RESPECT TO 50-KT SPEED CRITERIA...BUT STILL CAPABLE OF OCNL DAMAGE TO TREES/LIMBS AND WEAK STRUCTURES...ESPECIALLY ALONG NW-FACING SLOPES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VIS AND IR IMAGERY EACH INDICATE SMALL MIDLEVEL CYCLONIC CIRCULATION/VORTICITY MAX BEHIND THIS TSTM CLUSTER...MOVING SEWD OVER NERN KY ATTM...THAT MAY BE AIDING IN ASCENT AND SUBTLE STEEPENING OF WEAK AMBIENT LAPSE RATES ALOFT. FOREGOING AIR MASS FROM SERN KY INTO WRN NC SHOULD CONTINUE TO DESTABILIZE AMIDST STG SFC DIABATIC HEATING...AND FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AS REPRESENTED BY 70S F SFC DEW POINTS IN LOWER ELEVATIONS. RESULTANT MODIFICATIONS TO RAOBS AND FCST SOUNDINGS YIELDS 1500-2000 J/KG MLCAPE...AMIDST ONLY 20-25 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDE. LOW-MIDDLE LEVEL FLOW AND SHEAR EACH ARE RATHER WEAK ALREADY AND BECOME LESS WITH SEWD EXTENT ALONG PROJECTED PATH. MEAN-WIND VECTORS SHOULD REMAIN DIRECTED FROM NW AND NNW...ENCOURAGING SEWD NET TRANSLATION OF COLD POOL WITH SOME SSEWD PROPAGATION ALSO POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR THREAT IS FCST TO INCREASE THROUGH AFTN...WITH INITIAL MIXTURE OF CONVECTIVE MODES POSSIBLE...INCLUDING SUPERCELLS...EVENTUALLY EVOLVING INTO QUASI-LINEAR AND CLUSTERED SYSTEMS. ALL SVR MODES ARE POSSIBLE DURING FIRST FEW HOURS OF THIS REGIME...EVOLVING TO WIND-DOMINANT. WW LIKELY WILL BE REQUIRED OVER THIS AREA DURING NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWED COLD FRONT FROM PEMBINA COUNTY ND SWWD ACROSS PIR AREA...FCST TO MOVE EWD ACROSS DISCUSSION AREA. LARGE AREA OF MIDLEVEL CONVECTION AND ASSOCIATED BKN-OVC CLOUD COVER IS MOVING EWD ACROSS N-CENTRAL/NERN SD...ERN ND AND NWRN MN AT ABOUT 30 KT...SOMEWHAT OUTPACING SFC COLD FRONT. HOWEVER...SOME OF THIS CLOUD/PRECIP MASS REMAINS BEHIND FRONT...AND BULK OF CLOUD AREA AHEAD OF FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO INHIBIT BOTH PACE AND MAGNITUDE OF DIABATIC SFC HEATING IN WARM SECTOR. RELATED WEAKENING OF PREFRONTAL MLCINH IS GRADUAL...BASED ON MODIFIED RAOBS AND FCST SOUNDINGS...BUT SHOULD ALLOW RELATIVELY UNIMPEDED/SFC-BASED EFFECTIVE INFLOW PARCELS BY ABOUT 21Z. AS SUCH...WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS ALREADY EVIDENT WITHIN CLOUD/PRECIP PLUME MAY BECOME SFC-BASED IN SITU. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT ALSO IS POSSIBLE ALONG COLD FRONT ITSELF...AS WELL AS AREAS OF DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ALONG SRN/ERN RIM OF CLOUD/PRECIP MASS. SFC MOIST AXIS...WITH PATCHY CONFIGURATION OF MOSTLY MID-UPPER 60S F SFC DEW POINTS...WAS DRAWN JUST AHEAD OF FRONT OVER ND AND SWD ACROSS ERN SD NEAR MHE/YKN AREA...WHERE LOW-70S VALUES WERE OBSERVED. AXIS SHOULD SHIFT EWD AHEAD OF FRONT AMIDST SSWLY/SWLY SFC FLOW. RELATIVELY VEERED/5-10 KT SFC WINDS WILL LIMIT LOW-LEVEL SRH/CONVERGENCE...HOWEVER DEEP SHEAR STILL WILL SUPPORT POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELLS AND FOR BOWING OF ANY QUASI-LINEAR MODES. DEEP SHEAR OVER ERN ND AND NRN MN SHOULD INCREASE WITH APCH OF HEIGHT-GRADIENT ENHANCEMENTS PRECEDING SK SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THIS SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO EFFECTIVE-SHEAR MAGNITUDES INCREASING WITH TIME TO 45-55 KT RANGE OVER MORE OF ERN ND/NWRN MN AND 35-45 KT ELSEWHERE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM INITIATION IS EXPECTED SOON ALONG A FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDING ACROSS CNTRL IL. A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WILL LIKELY PROMOTE A FEW SVR STORMS WITH STRONG WINDS/LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE. AN UPGRADE TO SLIGHT RISK IS BEING PLANNED FOR 20Z AND TRENDS ACROSS THE AREA ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY HAS RECENTLY SHOWN MORE AGITATED CU ALONG A FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM 20 NNE PIA /IN CNTRL IL/ SWWD TO SZL IN NW MO. TEMPERATURES AHEAD OF THIS BOUNDARY ARE IN THE MID TO UPPER 90S AMIDST LOW TO MID 70S DEWPOINTS. AS A RESULT...STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE OVER 2500 J PER KG PER RAP-BASED MESOANALYSIS/ EXISTS ACROSS THE AREA. MODIFIED 12Z RAOBS AND RECENT MESOANALYSIS REVEAL LITTLE TO NO CINH REMAINS AND TSTM INITIATION IS EXPECTED SOON. ONCE THUNDERSTORM INITIATION OCCURS...THERE IS A POTENTIAL FOR QUICK UPDRAFT GROWTH WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF BOTH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. SHEAR ACROSS THE AREA IS GENERALLY LOW WITH MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATING EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES AROUND 25 KT. HOWEVER...RECENT WV SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A COMPACT DISTURBANCE MOVING THROUGH CNTRL IA. AS THIS FEATURES MOVES INTO THE MID MS VALLEY...SOME INCREASE IN VERTICAL SHEAR IS POSSIBLE...IN ADDITION TO ENHANCED LARGE-SCALE LIFT. THIS COMBINATION OF THESE FACTORS FAVORS AN INCREASED SVR RISK WITH ANY TSTMS THAT DO DEVELOP ACROSS THE AREA. SOME POTENTIAL ALSO EXISTS FOR COLD POOL CONGLOMERATION AND UPSCALE GROWTH...ALTHOUGH UNCERTAINTY IS HIGH REGARDING THAT SCENARIO ATTM. AN UPGRADE TO SLIGHT RISK IS BEING PLANNED FOR 20Z AND TRENDS ACROSS THE AREA ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INITIALLY CONDITIONAL SVR POTENTIAL SHOULD BECOME BETTER FOCUSED AND DEFINED OVER MUCH OF DISCUSSION AREA DURING NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...AND WW MAY BE REQUIRED. DAMAGING GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL WOULD BE PRIMARY CONCERNS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS COLD FRONT FROM CENTRAL SD SWWD ACROSS SANDHILLS NEAR VTN TO NEAR AKO. FRONT SHOULD PROCEED SLOWLY ESEWD OVER N-CENTRAL/SWRN NEB THROUGH REMAINDER AFTN. AHEAD OF FRONT...SUBTLE CONFLUENCE AXES WERE DRAWN NEAR HLC-ODX-ONL AND ITR-LBF-HON LINES. FCST SOUNDINGS STILL SHOW 50-150 J/KG MLCINH OVER MOST OF THIS AREA...BUT CONTINUED STG SFC HEATING SHOULD ERODE THAT OVER NEXT 2-3 HOURS. FRONT AND CONFLUENCE LINES ARE POTENTIAL FOCI FOR INITIATION. ALSO...INITIALLY ELEVATED/MIDLEVEL-ROOTED CONVECTION MOVING ESEWD OVER N-CENTRAL NEB MAY BECOME SFC-BASED WHILE MOVING EWD TOWARD MO RIVER VALLEY MOIST AXIS. MOISTURE PLUME OVER ERN NEB IS CHARACTERIZED BY UPPER 60S TO 70S F SFC DEW POINTS...COMBINING WITH SFC HEATING AND STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT TO YIELD MLCAPE NEAR 3000 J/KG. DEEP SHEAR WILL BE MRGL FOR SUPERCELLS BUT FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED MULTICELLS AND QUASI-LINEAR SEGMENTS...WITH 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES. LIMITING FACTOR FOR BOTH SHEAR AND CONVERGENCE WILL BE LACK OF MORE ROBUST SFC FLOW...WITH WINDS OBSERVED FROM CALM TO 10 KT ACROSS MUCH OF THIS AREA. FLOW MAY INCREASE SOMEWHAT THROUGH REMAINDER AFTN AS HEATING/MIXING CONTINUE...AND AS ISALLOBARIC FORCING INCREASES N OF AREA DUE TO STG SHORTWAVE TROUGH NEAR CANADIAN BORDER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE THROUGHOUT THE REGION FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. MOST OF THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN SUB-SEVERE BUT BRIEF/ISOLATED SVR IS POSSIBLE. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM ACTIVITY HAS GRADUALLY INCREASED AND STRENGTHENED ALONG A FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM A SFC LOW CENTERED ALONG THE CNTRL NY/VT BORDER SWWD ACROSS CNTRL NY INTO N-CNTRL PA. INSTABILITY ACROSS THE AREA IS FAIRLY MODEST /MLCAPE AROUND 1500 J PER KG/ AND SHEAR IS WEAK /19 KT 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR PER BGM VAD PROFILE/...WHICH SHOULD LIMIT THE OVERALL SVR THREAT. TSTM ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE WITH BRIEF/ISOLATED SVR POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY AS A RESULT OF CELL MERGERS. HOWEVER...THE TREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN TOO LOW TO MERIT A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS SCNTRL MO AND SRN IL OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS AS CELLS INITIATE AND INCREASE IN COVERAGE. WW ISSUANCE MAY BECOME NECESSARY THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC ANALYSIS CURRENTLY SHOWS 1006 MB LOW OVER SCNTRL IL WITH A FRONTAL WIND SHIFT EXTENDING WWD ACROSS SCNTRL MO. SFC DEWPOINTS ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY ARE IN THE LOWER 70S F AND MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED IN THE 2500 TO 3000 J/KG RANGE. AS LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE INCREASES ALONG THE WIND SHIFT...THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INITIATE AND MOVE SEWD ACROSS THE MCD AREA. IN ADDITION TO THE INSTABILITY AND MOISTURE...MESOANALYSIS ALSO SHOWS AN AXIS OF VERY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES EXTENDING NEWD ACROSS SRN MO INTO SCNTRL IL WHERE 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES ARE ESTIMATED TO BE ABOVE 8.0 C/KM. THIS MAY HELP ENHANCE DOWNDRAFT SPEEDS AS CELLS DEVELOP THIS EVENING MAKING WIND DAMAGE POSSIBLE. HAIL MAY ALSO OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER CELLS DUE TO THE MAGNITUDE OF INSTABILITY. CONVECTIVE COVERAGE SHOULD REMAIN SCATTERED AND DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS WEAK SUGGESTING THE SEVERE THREAT COULD REMAIN MARGINAL

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE...PRIMARILY ACROSS ERN TWO-THIRDS OF WW. A MORE CONCENTRATED SVR WIND THREAT MAY EVOLVE FROM SVR TSTMS NEAR DNV THROUGH EARLY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MESOANALYSIS REVEALS A FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDING GENLY E/SEWD FROM A WEAK SFC LOW NEAR DNV TO NEAR IND...AND A SFC TROF/WIND SHIFT EXTENDING SWD FROM THE LOW INTO SRN IL. STG/OCNLY SVR TSTMS CONTINUE ALONG THE FRONT AND SFC TROF. SOME ADDITIONAL INCREASE IN COVERAGE IS POSSIBLE THRU THE EARLY EVENING HOURS AS THE FRONTAL BOUNDARY SAGS SWD INTO A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AND UNCAPPED AIR MASS. SUBTLE ADDITIONAL FORCING FROM AN UPPER LEVEL IMPULSE MOVING EWD ACROSS THE NRN OH VALLEY MAY ALSO CONTRIBUTE TO ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT. ALTHOUGH EFFECTIVE SHEAR REMAINS WEAK /AOB 25 KTS/...TSTMS MAY ORGANIZE AROUND MERGING COLD POOLS AND MOVE SEWD WITH A LOCALLY-ENHANCED SVR WIND/HAIL THREAT THROUGH 02-03Z. THIS APPEARS MOST LIKELY TO OCCUR NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF THE FRONT AND SURFACE TROF CURRENTLY NEAR DNV...WHERE TSTM COVERAGE/COLD POOL GENERATION POTENTIAL IS GREATEST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE ACROSS ERN MN AND SHOULD SPREAD INTO WRN WI AND NRN IA OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER STORMS. WW ISSUANCE CAN NOT BE RULED OUT EAST AND SOUTH OF THE CURRENT WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN LINE OF STORMS IS ONGOING ACROSS ERN AND SCNTRL MN ALONG A SFC TROUGH AND PRE-FRONTAL WIND SHIFT. AHEAD OF THE WIND SHIFT...MODERATE INSTABILITY IS ANALYZED ACROSS MUCH OF ERN MN WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED IN THE 1500 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE WITH WEAKER INSTABILITY LOCATED ACROSS WCNTRL WI. AS THE BROKEN LINE OF STORMS MOVES TOWARD THE ERN PART OF WW 507...THE INSTABILITY ALONG WITH 30 TO 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS...SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO MAINTAIN A SEVERE THREAT. THE STRONGER INSTABILITY IS LOCATED SWD ACROSS SRN MN INTO NRN IA WHERE THE SEVERE POTENTIAL MAY BE MORE FAVORABLE THAN AREAS TO THE NORTH. ANY BOWING LINE-SEGMENT AND OR EMBEDDED MULTICELL CORE THAT CAN PERSIST SHOULD HAVE A THREAT FOR WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS SCNTRL NEB OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AS UPDRAFTS INCREASE IN INTENSITY...THE STRONGER CELLS COULD BE ACCOMPANIED BY STRONG GUSTY WINDS AND HAIL. WW ISSUANCE CAN NOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS THE REGION LATE THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING NEAR NORTH PLATTE NEB ON A SHARPLY DEFINED COLD FRONT ADVANCING SEWD ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS. AHEAD OF THE FRONT...MODERATE INSTABILITY IS ANALYZED WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED IN THE 2000 TO 2500 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...THE THEDFORD NEB WSR-88D VWP SHOWS 0-6 KM SHEAR OF ABOUT 40 KT. THIS COMBINATION OF INSTABILITY AND SHEAR SHOULD BE SUPPORTIVE OF A SEVERE THREAT AS CELLS INCREASE IN COVERAGE LATE THIS EVENING. AS THE STORMS MOVE SEWD INTO A CORRIDOR OF STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE. THE INSTABILITY MAY BE ENOUGH FOR HAIL ESPECIALLY AS THE CELLS MOVE SEWD INTO THE STRONGER INSTABILITY. THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED DUE TO A COOLING BOUNDARY LAYER LATE THIS EVENING INTO THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. THE COLD FRONT MAY ALSO TEND TO UNDERCUT THE STORMS AS WELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WHILE THE OVERALL SVR THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO DIMINISH...AN ISOLATED SVR TSTM WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE BEYOND WW 508 EXPIRATION AT 03Z. CURRENTLY...AN ADDITIONAL WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED BEYOND 03Z HOWEVER LOCAL WFO EXTENSIONS MAY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS OVER SRN IL AND SWRN IND HAVE INTENSIFIED SINCE 00Z IN WW 508...WHICH WAS RECENTLY LOCALLY EXTENDED ACROSS PORTIONS OF SWRN IL. THESE TSTMS WERE ALONG AND JUST IN ADVANCE OF A COLD FRONT WHICH EXTENDED FROM NEAR ST. LOUIS EWD INTO CENTRAL IND. THE AIR MASS IN ADVANCE OF ON-GOING TSTMS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE /MLCAPES OF 1500 - 2000 J/KG/ THOUGH WITH SLOWLY INCREASING CINH DUE TO THE CESSATION OF DAYTIME HEATING. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT AN ISOLATED SVR WIND THREAT WILL EXIST BEYOND WW 508 EXPIRATION AT 03Z...AND ADDITIONAL LOCAL WFO EXTENSIONS MAY BE NEEDED. CONTINUED BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING WILL LIKELY LEAD TO A DIMINISHING OVERALL THREAT WITH TIME...AND THUS AN ADDITIONAL WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS...SOME SEVERE...ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE DEVELOPING ACROSS WRN IA AND ERN NEB THROUGH THE NIGHT INTO THIS MORNING...WITH ACTIVITY TENDING TO MOVE TO THE SSE. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREAT...THOUGH LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT. EITHER LOCAL WFO WATCH EXTENSIONS IN AREA AND/OR A NEW WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE WRN/SWRN FLANK OF A CLUSTER OF STORMS MOVING SSEWD THROUGH FAR NERN NEB...FAR SERN SD...AND NWRN IA. THE NEW AND EXISTING STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST OVERNIGHT INTO EARLY THIS MORNING GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF RESIDUAL MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY RESIDING OVER SRN/ERN NEB INTO WRN IA...AND DOWNSTREAM INTO KS/MO. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED DEEP LAYER CONVERGENCE ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE TSTM CLUSTER WHICH IS CO-LOCATED ALONG A SSEWD MOVING COLD FRONT. THIS ASCENT WILL PERSIST THROUGH THE NIGHT/EARLY MORNING ALONG THE FRONT AND WITHIN A REGION OF UPPER LEVEL DIFFLUENCE IN NWLY FLOW ALOFT. WEAK WAA AROUND 700 MB MAY FURTHER AID NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS ERN NEB/WRN IA PORTION OF THE TSTM CLUSTER. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-35 KT...RESIDUAL INSTABILITY AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES LOCATED ALONG AND DOWNSTREAM OF THE ONGOING STORMS SUGGEST HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WINDS SHOULD REMAIN A THREAT INTO THE EARLY MORNING...AS THE COLD FRONT/DEEP LAYER ASCENT ADVANCES SSEWD.
